ازدرعنا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَرَعْنَا (izdaraʕnā) /iz.da.raʕ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# اُزْدُرِعْنَا (uzduriʕnā) /uz.du.riʕ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
